text: The EC 339 A01BP wellbore has been completed for production. The wellbore was spud on January 14, 2007 and drilled to TD on January 25, 2007 at a depth of 7892'MD / 7816' TVD.  The wellbore was TA'd on February 06, 2007.  The EC 339 A platform was installed over the TA wellbore stub and the well tied-back and completion for production. Completion operations of the well began on July 30, 2007 and were completed on August 11, 2007.  The well was completed as a single, GP, oil completion in the "Ang B 7200' Sd. with perforations of 7658' - 7750' MD.  The well is shut-in waiting on pipeline and facilities hook up. Expected start of production operations is scheduled for mid September 2007.
